meta.title: Changelog — everything fly.ai shipped
meta.description: Everything fly.ai has shipped since day one: the fly brain, games, Trader Flies, the Fly Desk, $FLYAI and the site, day by day.

head.title: Everything we shipped
head.lede: From a fly brain playing a fighting game on day one to a desk of fly brains trading real money. Newest first.

e.d1009a: Calmer trading. The Fly Desk and every fly wallet now hold a position at least 12 hours and swap at most twice a day. Far fewer round trips, far less lost to fees.
e.d1009b: One trading engine for everyone. The Fly Desk, the fly wallets and the partner pools now run on one shared trading core. A fix lands everywhere at once.
e.d1009c: No catching a falling FLYAI. New $FLYAI dip buys wait while it is still falling, on the desk and in the wallets.
e.d1009d: Every decision graded. Each buy is graded 24 hours later, per strategy part, so we can see which parts earn and which don't.
e.d1008a: Robot Fights. Bet on robot fights in USDG, $FLYAI or ETH. Pick a side, the pool pays the winners.
e.d1008b: Market mood. When the whole market turns risk-off, the flies trade it differently: stops relative to the market, dip buys on what fell with it.
e.d1008c: Truer wallet numbers. Fly wallet profit now counts withdrawals and ignores balance quirks, so the leaderboard shows what a fly really made.
e.d1007a: Partners. Other NFT collections can join: every NFT gets its own trading wallet, plus a shared pot paid to holders.
e.d1007b: A second $FLYAI pool. A new $FLYAI / USDG pool opened on another Robinhood Chain DEX.
e.d1007c: 40M $FLYAI burned. Total supply is now exactly 960,000,000.
e.d1007d: Earn. Lend your idle USDG on Robinhood Chain from the Earn page.
e.d1007e: More chains, Polymarket. The Fly Desk trades Base, BNB Chain and Arbitrum tokens through Relay, and bets on Polymarket by itself.
e.d1007f: Pay from any chain. The swap box and wallet funding take ETH or USDC from Base, Arbitrum and Ethereum, and BERA or USDC from Berachain.
e.d1006a: Always invested. A fly's idle cash goes to work in its best-scored picks instead of sitting still, and $FLYAI is never sold under what it cost.
e.d1005a: How it works. One page on the brain, Trader Flies, the pots, partners and fees, in six languages.
e.d1005b: Buy $FLYAI on the site. A buy and sell box on the token page.
e.d1005c: Holders vote every day. $FLYAI holders sign a free daily ballot (Safer, Balanced or Degen) that sets the desk's style for the next day.
e.d1005d: Fly wallets go cross-chain. A fly's wallet can buy Base, BNB Chain and Arbitrum tokens with its USDG, and sell them back home.
e.d1004a: The Fly Desk goes live. Real money, traded by a real fly brain, with the profit shared by Trader Fly holders. Payouts are shown per holder on the desk page.
e.d1004b: Deposit promo. Fund a fly wallet, win $FLYAI. The first round's slots filled.
e.d1003a: Bounties. Get paid in $FLYAI for memes, bots and research. Post work, apply, get picked.
e.d1003b: Usernames and the leaderboard. Pick a name and see the best fly wallets, live. Inventory and Leaderboard got pages of their own.
e.d1003c: Copy trading and options. A fly wallet can follow top traders and switch on setups like trend following and $FLYAI dips.
e.d1002a: Fly Wallets. Every Trader Fly has its own trading wallet. Fund it, choose how it trades, withdraw any time. The first real trade went through.
e.d1002b: Colosseum Season 2. A new season of Trader Fly tournaments, with a FlightPass shop and the next season starting by itself.
e.d1001a: Breeding. Merge two Trader Flies into one: the child keeps a number and inherits traits from both parents, with a chance of mutation.
e.d1001b: Burn a fly. A holder can burn a fly; its share of the pot goes to the flies still alive.
e.d1001c: First compute payout. September's mining pool was paid out to the people who mined with their browsers.
e.d0930a: Fly Colosseum. Seasons of Trader Fly tournaments for $FLYAI.
e.d0930b: Community fix to the GPU brain. A contributor found and fixed a silent edge reordering when the brain's wiring is loaded onto the GPU.
e.d0929a: Trader Flies revealed. Traits and rarity (Common, Uncommon, Rare, Legendary) rolled on chain.
e.d0929b: Fly Slots and Fly Race. Spin the reels while a fly brain reacts, or bet on six fly brains racing to the fruit by smell.
e.d0929c: Fly Market. Buy and sell Trader Flies on the site.
e.d0928a: FlightPass and autopilot. Put your flies on autopilot: they play games, run missions and breed for you, with automatic withdrawals.
e.d0926a: Trader Flies mint. 1,000 genesis Trader Flies on Robinhood Chain went on sale.
e.d0926b: Hardware NFTs. Pre-order a pocket fly: $FLYAI pets you can hold.
e.d0921a: Six languages. The site speaks English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 한국어, Türkçe and Español.
e.d0919a: Fly Roulette. A cartoon 3-D roulette with real $FLYAI bets against the house, provably fair.
e.d0919b: Flinder. Tinder for flies: a real brain swipes on dating profiles, and a match needs both brains to agree.
e.d0919c: Real tokens on the fly market. The Flybook fly market moved to real Robinhood Chain token prices, and every fly trades.
e.d0918a: Merch. Fly shirts and more in the shop.
e.d0917a: Compute. Mine with your browser and earn $FLYAI. USDC and card payments too.
e.d0916a: A better 3-D world. Flies forage, track odour plumes, mate, lay eggs and dodge spiders in the simulation.
e.d0915a: Fly Radio. A radio station played by a real fly brain.
e.d0915b: Relationships in Flybook. Flies make friends and rivals, and the first token trading arrived.
e.d0914a: Be My ValentFly. A bachelor show where flies are the contestants, run by the brain. A community contribution.
e.d0914b: Agent skills. Make Claude and other agents talk like a fly.
e.d0913a: Flybook is live. Sign in with a wallet, make, tune and breed flies, like and comment, and duel in the Arena.
e.d0913b: pip install flybrain. The brain became a Python package on PyPI.
e.d0913c: Wiz. Summon a giant wizard puppeted by the full connectome in the 3-D world.
e.d0913d: Two brains signal. One fly sees a threat and its wings sing; a second fly hears it with its own ears and reacts.
e.d0912a: $FLYAI launches. A fair launch on Pons, on Robinhood Chain: graduated to Uniswap V4, liquidity locked for good, no team allocation, no tax.
e.d0912b: Roadmap. What's done and what's next, in the open.
e.d0911a: Open source. The whole fly brain, 166,700 neurons, runs in real time on a laptop GPU, plays SSH Fighter as a bot and won its first match. Code, notebook and site went public.
